contracts.noBypass: Signed ingress commits replay advancement and outbox insertion through HeptaEvidenceStore before reporting readiness.
contracts.canonicalDigest: authbus_text_claims derives subject, scope and payload digest from canonical request fields.
contracts.authorityIdentity: The agent identity supplies subject and domain-separated scope; the Evidence-owned persistent time floor supplies lifecycle time.
contracts.ambiguousOutcome: A committed message is preserved when authority changes; readiness is rechecked before success.
contracts.terminalCleanup: Outbox delivery owner performs claim, retry, acknowledgement and quarantine lifecycle under the persistent time floor.
contracts.recoveryOwner: Evidence store plus ReplayCheckpointFile own restart rollback detection.
contracts.unavailableBehavior: No explicit trust configuration or non-ready generation fails closed.
contracts.correlation: Delivery ID and queue receipt digest cross the component boundary.

contracts.noBypass: The qualified product entry accepts an entered sealed kernel.operations handle and only AuthBusExecutionPort; it does not accept caller-minted operation metadata.
contracts.canonicalDigest: The durable payload digest and AuthBus effect digest bind the exact Bao request, destination and durable operation identity.
contracts.authorityIdentity: Current durable scope, operation ID, semantic digest, destination, payload, owner generation and writer fence are validated before AuthBus reservation or provider I/O.
contracts.ambiguousOutcome: kernel.operations is already Indeterminate before provider I/O; transport ambiguity cannot be retried under a fresh operation ID and AuthBus preserves its reservation conservatively.
contracts.terminalCleanup: Authenticated AuthBus settlement and a separate kernel.operations reconciliation receipt are both required; provider success cannot forge terminal operation state.
contracts.recoveryOwner: DurableOperationStore recovers the exact operation identity with a new generation/fence and rejects the stale entered handle.
contracts.unavailableBehavior: Missing, stale or drifted operation identity fails before trusted time, quota reservation or provider use.
contracts.correlation: Operation scope/ID/generation/semantic digest, AuthBus effect/reservation and provider receipt are returned as one caller-visible correlation record.
